title: Bidirectional RAG: Safe Self-Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation Through Multi-Stage Validation
why_relevant: Proposes a validated write-back mechanism using NLI grounding and attribution to prevent hallucination pollution in self-improving RAG corpora, tangentially touching on safety/validation.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on corpus expansion rather than robustness to noisy/adversarial/conflicting evidence; validation is for self-generated content, not unreliable retrieval.
